hypothese: Ad blocks end too early. After the last strong ad image the head gives only medium evidence (trailer, countdown, sponsor at the block end, logo already back), and the HSMM cuts there. The rule works on the head logits before calibration. A sure ad block is marked where the 5-s mean of z is above 4. For 45 s after that, every second that is not sure show (z above -4) gets an ad bonus of 3*(1-dt/45) that fades to zero. Block starts and sure show seconds stay untouched. The output is pre-conditioned with a fixed affine map (0.63*z - 1.10), so that the undamped Newton step in opt_lauf.platt converges.
begruendung:
Klasse nachbearbeitung came from the bandit (Zug 0.93). The fault being attacked is the edge (Kante), and within it the ad block that ends too early.

Evidence comes from a new, almost exact proxy on the training part. It used 134 training recordings that have old signal dumps (emit-signals). The K copy was trained on the other 393 recordings, predicted every second, calibrated by Platt on the Kalibrierteil, and decoded with the production HSMM. Under hsmm the emission is pure NN, so the proxy matches the real decoder.

- Edge offset: block starts have a median of 0 s. Block ends have a median of -1 s, but q10 is -33 s.
- 57 blocks end more than 10 s early, 2640 s in total, median tail 34 s. In the tail the logo is already back (0.75) and the head gives p 0.25.
- The arm file itself, run through the exact pipeline with opt_lauf.platt converging (a about 0.98), gave in seed 0 / seed 1:
  - IoU mean +0.0041 / +0.0023
  - Aufnahme-Median +0.0021 / +0.0013
  - better/worse 29/16 and 28/15, no recording below -0.10
  - ad time +1.2 percentage points
- A flat post-Platt bias toward ad costs +3.5 percentage points of ad time for +0.0029. Per added ad second the arm is about three times as effective, so the gain is not just a level shift.

Why this is not in the graveyard: the earlier 'Vorwaerts-Halten 4-30 s' (diagnosis in auto_blockende_logo, never run) was measured in a coarse 4-s Viterbi proxy, without a gate, as error seconds. That proxy counts phantom seconds, which block IoU does not count at all. My measurement uses 1-s steps, the production HSMM and block IoU, which makes the old measurement invalid. 017 (weichkappe) went the other way: it squeezed the logits.

Side finding, important for the instrument: opt_lauf.platt diverges on non-monotone pre-processing (a about 1e11). An unsharp mask looked like +0.007 because of this and is really -0.004 to -0.008. The K instability on the referee set could have the same cause; Platt a,b should be logged per seed.

Details are in werbe_nachhall.befund.md.
